summary: Join our comprehensive training on Key Risk Indicators and Early Warning Systems. Equip yourself with essential tools to foresee and manage risks proactively.
lede: Key risk indicators (KRIs) help risk and compliance professionals monitor emerging threats and spot when action may be needed. The course covers choosing relevant measures, linking them to objectives, setting thresholds and data-quality standards, building dashboards, and interpreting trends to communicate alerts and guide response planning.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals responsible for identifying, monitoring, and reporting risks within their organizations.
audience: Risk and compliance managers in banks, insurance
Project and program managers in development organizations
Corporate governance and enterprise risk management (ERM)
modules: Early Warning Systems: Concepts and Architecture
Case Studies in Early Warning Applications
Behavioral Aspects and Cognitive Biases in Risk Perception
Communicating and Acting on Early Warning Signals
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of risk management principles and basic data analysis skills. Familiarity with enterprise risk frameworks is beneficial.
